cohort: Recorded correctness-review outcome events joined to ships and reviewer scope. Executed subset requires scope.cached=0; cached and unknown flags remain explicit. This is observational, not a randomized model contrast.
timeBasis: ship ts_start, UTC; lower inclusive, upper exclusive
reason: None of the post-flip review inputs matches the seven historical bank diffs. Complete claims from this bank cannot partition production post-flip FAIL events into labelled-defect and extra causes.
limitations: Extras can be valid defects; extra is not a false-positive label.
The pre/post and model cohorts differ in machine, workload, chunking and selection.
An extra plus a labelled blocker does not imply that removing the extra clears the review.
A representative post-flip input cohort with complete parent-task evidence and semantic claim/label adjudication is required for attribution.
query:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.ts_start < :flip THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END period,
 r.model, count(*) review_events, count(DISTINCT r.ship_id) review_ships,
 sum(r.status='fail') fails, sum(r.status='pass') passes,
 sum(r.status='inconclusive') inconclusive, sum(r.status='error') errors,
 sum(sc.diff_sha256 IS NULL) missing_diff_identity,
 sum(sc.diff_sha256 IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(:diffs))) bank_matches,
 sum(sc.cached=1) recorded_cached, sum(sc.cached=0) executed_review_events,
 sum(sc.cached=0 AND r.status='fail') executed_fails,
 sum(sc.cached IS NULL) unknown_cache_status
FROM commit_reviews r JOIN commit_ships s USING(ship_id)
LEFT JOIN commit_review_scope sc ON sc.ship_id=r.ship_id AND sc.reviewer=r.reviewer
WHERE r.reviewer='correctness-reviewer'
 AND r.model IN ('sonnet','gpt-5.6-sol')
 AND s.ts_start>=:start AND s.ts_start<:end
GROUP BY period,r.model ORDER BY period,r.model
